name: bench-chassis
description: Read BenchAGI Chassis capability, config, health, manifest, and harness state through existing /api/v1/chassis endpoints. Calls use Chassis API keys via X-API-Key; cowork bearer tokens are not valid for these routes.

BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY.description: Chassis API key in bench_<instanceId>_<secret> format.
BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY.missing_message: BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY is required for bench-chassis MCP calls. Set it to a Chassis API key in bench_<instanceId>_<secret> format.

auth.missing_message: BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY is required for bench-chassis MCP calls. Set it to a Chassis API key in bench_<instanceId>_<secret> format.
auth.invalid_bearer_message: Looks like you passed a Bearer token. The Chassis MCP needs BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY (format bench_<instanceId>_<secret>). Cowork tokens are for /api/v1/cowork/*, not /chassis/*.

tools.name: chassis_capabilities
tools.description: Dynamic capability registry for agent introspection.

tools.name: chassis_openapi
tools.description: OpenAPI spec for all Chassis routes.

detailed.description: Include recent heartbeat detail when true.

diff.description: Include diff against stored manifest when true.

channel.description: Optional admin override for the resolved harness channel.
